prompt_text: Generate a video of a androgynous-presenting adult aged 18-29 with light skin and a slim build, wearing a short-sleeved shirt and pants. A aged, medium, black-and-gray linework tattoo depicting butterfly is located on the outer forearm. The subject is standing and slowly rotates the torso through a small angle in an indoor setting under bright lighting. Capture a close-up oblique view with focus primarily on the tattoo. Let a hand briefly overlap a small edge of the tattoo, leaving most of the design visible and identifiable. Keep clothing clear of the design, orient the tattooed surface toward the camera, and retain enough detail for tattoo recognition even in dim or full-body views.
